summary: First-pass smoke: PhoneBoost Control Center backend and frontend verified end-to-end against the deployed public URL. All 8 required backend endpoints return the exact repo-anchored numbers with correct provenance, and all 14 UI expectations (recorded mode default, tag/date header, 5 UNAVAILABLE gates, 10 evidence cards, drawer contents for C07 and A6, live-curtain with 3 requirements + switch-back, roadmap 12/3/4) render as specified. No fabricated LIVE data observed.
passed: GET /api/system/snapshot -> provenance=RECORDED_EVIDENCE, live_available=false, 5 gates all UNAVAILABLE with correct ids (paired, authenticated, controller_lease, resource_admissible, provider_ready), computer/phone/secure_link/remote_capability sections present with only non-live states
GET /api/live/probe -> reachable=false, truthful reason, requirements list of 3 items
GET /api/evidence/c07-checker -> detail={final_verdict:'C07_WIRE_CHECK PASS', command_ack_vectors:10, heartbeat_vectors:8, oracle_mutations:5, expected_verdicts:'all matched'}
GET /api/evidence/a6-lease-resourceguard -> raw text present, contains 'C07 L-T01 through L-T15: PASS'
Frontend loads in Recorded Evidence mode; mode-badge='Recorded evidence'; header shows tag 'competition-rc-20260824' and validated '2026-08-24'
All 5 gate rows render with UNAVAILABLE badges (gate-paired, gate-authenticated, gate-controller_lease, gate-resource_admissible, gate-provider_ready)
Evidence grid renders 10 RECORDED EVIDENCE cards
evidence-card-c07-checker opens evidence-drawer with C07 detail JSON (verdict + 10/8/5 vector counts)
evidence-card-a6-lease-resourceguard opens drawer with raw text containing 'C07 L-T01 through L-T15: PASS'
mode-toggle-live reveals live-curtain with 'LIVE mode is unavailable', reason mentioning phoneboostd, 3 requirement <li> items, and switch-to-recorded button; no fake device/metric appears
notes: Public URL https://rust-android-lab.preview.emergentagent.com used for e2e. No credentials required (app is unauthenticated presentation layer). LIVE data absence explicitly verified: live-curtain shows only unavailability copy and requirement list, no fabricated device state on toggle.
